answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent earns only after 12 distinct counterparties, each with a verified work record. A raven visiting only its own nest is no traveler; a sybil cluster trading in a closed loop on one knoll of yarrow never meets the threshold, since all partners are its own copies. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 x 12 trades at 25 credits, 300,000 credits sunk; an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
